card.name: Word 'maintenance' in anesthesia dosing
card.fires_on: Most strongly on the word "maintenance" after an anesthetic drug name, as in "DIPRIVAN maintenance infusion rates". It also fires, more weakly, on a few unrelated spots such as partway through names like SYMTUZA and Lhotse.

modes.label: Maintenance of anesthesia
modes.description: The word "maintenance" right after an anesthetic drug name or before "of anesthesia".
